stem: Why does Lonnie agree to let Asia cut her hair?

options.label: A
options.text: Lonnie decides that a free haircut from Asia is better than paying for a salon haircut.

options.label: B
options.text: Lonnie trusts that Asia s father has taught Asia how to cut hair properly.

options.label: C
options.text: Lonnie knows Asia has access to the right tools for cutting hair.

options.label: D
options.text: Lonnie believes that her hair will look just like the style she wants if Asia cuts it.
